newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAfrica's Corpgro sees growth through acquisitions.
newsitem.headline: SAfrica's Corpgro sees growth through acquisitions.

text.p: Industrial holding group Corpgro Ltd, formerly South East Rand Gold Holdings Ltd, sees significant growth through existing and further acquisitions.

"In the initial stage of implementing Corpgro's strategy it is anticipated that significant increases in both earnings and net asset value will be added by the (existing) acquisitions as well as further acquisitions...," the group said in a pre-listing statement on Friday.
The Johannesburg Stock Exchange has agreed to the transfer of the listing of Corpgro from the "Cash Companies" sector to the Industrial - "Stores" sector of the exchange lists from October 7.
Corpgro said the acquisition of F&F Building Supplies at the beginning of July represented the first of a series of further acquisitions.
It also acquired the businesses of Benoni Building Supplies CC and Benoni Building Supplies Vaal CC and Insulated Structures (Proprietary) Ltd earlier this year.
"Corpgro will continue to identify opportunities for growth in accordance with its business philosophy and investment criteria, to further enhance shareholder value in the long term," it said.
The group was committed to expand its interests into further industrial sectors.
"As soon as it is practical Corpgro will apply for its listing to be transferred to the Industrial- "Industrial Holdings" sector of the JSE lists," it said.
